environments.name: Low Earth orbit
hazards: trapped-belt and South Atlantic Anomaly radiation
environments.note: Delay is relay-satellite latency, not light time. Design values, approximate.

environments.name: Cislunar space
hazards: solar particle events outside the magnetosphere
environments.note: Earth-Moon light time is about 1.3 s each way. Design values, approximate.

representative.note: Two crew on a ~week-long surface stay with the IMM 7.5-day kit

environments.name: Deep space / Mars transit

sources.doc: McBrayer KT, Chai PR, Judd EL. Communication Delays, Disruptions, and Blackouts for Crewed Mars Missions. ASCEND 2022 (NTRS 20220013418)

environments.note: Delay grows from seconds near Earth to up to about 23 minutes near Mars. Every crewed Mars mission loses contact once for about two to three weeks around solar conjunction, at Mars or about two months after leaving it.

environments.name: Mars surface
hazards: solar conjunction blackout of two to three weeks

sources.doc: McBrayer KT, Chai PR, Judd EL. Communication Delays, Disruptions, and Blackouts for Crewed Mars Missions. ASCEND 2022 (NTRS 20220013418)

environments.note: One-way delay is about 3 to 23 minutes depending on planetary positions.

representative.note: Mars surface stay with EVAs, after ~13 months of microgravity transit
